firstPositionDivergence.meaning: first sampled ID/x/y difference, not first causal tick

control.nominalShadow: same realized travel and rear segments at authored rate; dose counterfactual only, not a control world

candidate.nominalShadow: same realized travel and rear segments at authored rate; dose counterfactual only, not a control world

sourceDose.interpretation: source-path dose accounting is reported separately from field maps and endogenous activity

method.peakDefinition: exact-equal 8-neighbor D plateaus within S; greedily spaced within the same F component at 0.15
method.recentFeet: all observed contacts in (t-20s,t], exact nearest-cell and distance <= 0.037 for map centers
method.X: F component cells within 0.15 of the highest-D eligible S cell; existing material from full preMaterialLayers
method.actualBirthMasks: compare event masks by ID; no inference from C or a proxy mask
method.mapComparisons: raw L1/max absolute/count/Jaccard plus normalized-to-total L1 where totals are positive
method.footMap: 24 by 24 world bins; same absolute count scale for both arms; normalized spatial L1 reported separately
